item: W4 rqls_assay_v2 under owned_supervisor_v1: control-only smoke, then full assay (numpy float; NOT a certificate)

supersedes_request.note: v1 (code/rqls_assay_v1.py sha256 bf13f4b8...) never ran and stays preserved; parent review found A/C1/C2 not gating and silent JSONL drops

commands: ONLY IF smoke supervisor receipt = EXITED, returncode 0, SETTLED and its JSONL has GATE A_anchors/C1/C2 pass=true and end.mode=smoke: same command with evidence/rqls_assay_v2.full.supervisor-config.json
child_argv: python3.14 -I -B code/rqls_assay_v2.py <out.jsonl> <budget> <classical.json> <old C1_ex24_positive.json> da95d092... <stop-receipt.json> smoke|full (see configs); child env = configs' env (threads 1, lane TMPDIR); -I ignores PYTHON* env so PYTHONOPTIMIZE cannot apply; the assay also refuses to run if sys.flags.optimize
processes: supervisor (stdlib, mostly sleeping) + one child; child in its own session/PGID; no grandchildren by design
gating: compute starts only after the supervisor wrote the launch record (stdin GO). In-child fail-closed gates: A anchors (7 checks), C1 (>=1 run, each >=1000 iterations, zero verified solutions on v=6), C2 (>=1 verified v=5 solution, all with 5 rays). Any gate failure -> GATE record, stop receipt, exit 3, no L/T stage runs. Smoke = gates only.
guard: supervisor samples every 2 s: free (statvfs lane), child RSS (/bin/ps), output bytes, wall; trips: RSS > 2 GiB, free < 12.2e9, outputs > 9 MiB, wall > max_wall (smoke 150 s, full 1800 s); on first trip exactly one SIGTERM to the child's PGID after identity check; wait <= 120 s; no escalation; UNSETTLED otherwise.

absolute_ends.full: launch + 1800 s (+120 s settlement + 60 s margin)

resources.output_enforcement: child JSONL writer raises CAP_STOP before exceeding 8 MiB (never drops records; stop receipt outside JSONL, exit 4); supervisor trips at 9 MiB total outputs; samples file bounded by 2 s cadence x max wall (<100 KB)

stages_full: A, C1, C2 (gates) -> L (local Jacobian/kernel excess at 300 classical forced-U Z7+3 points; Jacobian columns via the quadratic central-difference identity evaluated in float; kernel dimension is a numerical SVD rank estimate) -> C3-C7 calibrations -> T1 (Z7+3 forced random), T1t (forced form with corner triples fixed to real trines, parent headroom calibration), T1c (classical-start), T2 (Z9+1), T3 (Z5+5), T4 (unsym v=10: Parker B, Cay(D5), Cay(Z10)).
candidate_rule: numeric-only regardless of residual: maxdev<1e-8, all v^2 rays (merge 1-|<q,q'>|^2<1e-7), minsep>1e-6. Any v=10 candidate -> immediate parent notice; exact recognition only under a new GO.
scientific_consequence: misses UNKNOWN; kernel counts are numerical rank estimates at named classical points, not proofs
